# Paula Magdy — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Full-stack software engineer in Cairo, Egypt. Ships production systems
> end-to-end across TypeScript, PHP, and Python on AWS, Azure, and Huawei Cloud.

## About
Paula Magdy ships production systems end-to-end across multiple stacks —
TypeScript (Next.js/NestJS), PHP (Laravel), and Python (Django/Flask) — on AWS,
Azure, and Huawei Cloud. An AWS Certified Solutions Architect, he owns delivery
from data modeling and API architecture through CI/CD, monitoring, and security,
shipping government-grade and enterprise platforms that serve thousands of
concurrent users. Works at Challenge Group. Alumnus of October 6 University.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Cloud Practitioner; Huawei
HCCDP-Solution Architectures, HCCDA-Tech Essentials, and HCIA-AI certified.
